channel.title: Dry Humps
channel.description: Hidden feelings. Complicated love. Unexpected mistakes — real first-person confessions, shared without judgment.

item.title: The Salon Accident That Left Me Completely Exposed
item.description: A salon visit spirals into awkward mishaps, leaving one customer exposed and unsure how to handle an embarrassing chain of unexpected accidents.

item.title: The message I never sent
item.description: A message left in drafts for three years holds the words and memories its writer could never bring herself to send to someone she still remembers.

item.title: My best friend's older brother
item.description: A nineteen-year-old's attempt to hide a crush on her best friend's older brother fails during a rainy night when the family rule finally gives way.

item.title: The elevator stopped between floors
item.description: Trapped between floors with a stranger, one passenger notices lingering glances and wonders how long they can both keep pretending not to feel the tension.

item.title: What I never told my husband
item.description: A secret from two months before the wedding still weighs on a wife six years into marriage, especially because no one involved actually did anything wrong.

item.title: The weekend at the beach house
item.description: At a crowded beach-house weekend, eight friends feel certain they're unforgettable, but two of them soon discover their confidence may be misplaced.
